title: Fixed Twin-Wing Dough Sheeter
description: One newly authored complete fixed twin-wing dough-sheeter appearance: two full thick continuous return belts with internal support decks and full transverse end rollers extend from opposite sides of a central wide-roll head. Two thick side cheeks and a continuous curved upper hood enclose a real central roll gap. A whole four-legged base and four diagonal wing braces support the entire silhouette. No reused wringer, treadmill, mixer geometry or cloth/food payload. Three constant opaque PBR roles, one prop and zero scenes. Static open belt/roller topology only; no motor, transmission, adjustable pressure, food processing, hygiene, dimension compatibility, structural load or safety performance claim.
